tmp:1547: legalot ha-hastarot — the devotional act of revealing/uncovering the divine concealments (hastarot), disclosing God hidden even within concealment-within-concealment, achieved by drawing arikhut yamim/Da'at into Malkhut
tmp:1548: gilui — revelation/disclosure as a state, the emergence of the mochin from concealment likened to birth (leidah), opposite of he'lem (hiddenness)
tmp:1549: she-tzarikh litz'ok — the required act of crying out (the seventy cries/seven voices of David) in prayer and Torah study to bring the light of the Countenance from concealment to revelation, like the cry of a woman in labor
tmp:1551: lehachayot et atzmo ve-lavo lidei simchah — the practice of enlivening oneself and coming to joy by finding good points in oneself, warding off atzvut (sadness)
tmp:1552: lihyot ish mofet — becoming a 'man of wonders' (wonder-worker), a status attainable only by one who has broken free of the craving for eating (ta'avat akhilah)
tmp:1554: lehakhnia ha-koach ha-medameh — subduing the imaginative faculty (medameh), accomplished through the 'hand'/joy and hand-played musical instruments that enable prophecy ('be-yad ha-nevi'im adameh')
tmp:1555: lehakhnia u-levatel kesilut ha-sekhel — the tikkun of subduing and nullifying the foolishness of the intellect, effected through the aspect of the altar (mizbe'ach)/holy eating, cutting off the kelipot's nurture
tmp:1556: lehamshikh le-atzmo dibburim chamim ke-gachalei-esh — drawing down for oneself burning words like fiery coals from the Supernal Heart ('Tzur levavi') as prerequisite for drawing Torah explanations
tmp:1557: lehamshikh nekudot el ha-otiyot — drawing vowel-points (nekudot) into the letters through desire and yearning (cheshek/kissufin), per 'nekudot ha-kasef' (Song 1:11)
tmp:1558: yemale gronam — 'filling the throats' of Torah scholars (Yoma 71a), done via dancing (rikkudin) or a pidyon (redemption payment), the means of pouring wine-libation on the altar
tmp:1559: lehamtik ha-dinim al-yedei shorsham — sweetening the harsh judgments at their root, which is Binah, the 'wine that gladdens' (yayin ha-mesameach)
tmp:1560: lehinatzel mi-tachat memshaltam — being rescued from under the dominion of the shepherds of the Sitra Achra (false famous leaders who coerce people under their subjugation)
tmp:1561: she-margishin ta'am metikut be-ha-Torah — the experience of tasting sweetness in Torah study, a sweetening that saves one from the punishment of widowerhood (alman)
tmp:1562: lehistakel be-Elokut — gazing upon/contemplating Godliness, attainable only after rectifying the brit ('mi-besari echezeh Eloka'), the goal of tikkun ha-brit
tmp:1564: leha'alot et ha-dibbur le-shorshah — elevating and binding speech (the 'sea,' yam) back to its supernal root, via the gevurot ('yarah ba-yam') and tefillin
tmp:1565: lekasher et tefilato le-tzaddik ha-dor — the practice of binding one's prayer to the tzaddik of the generation (aspect of Moshe-Mashiach), who directs it to its proper gate
tmp:1566: leha'alot kol tefillah la-sha'ar ha-shayakh — the tzaddik's act of elevating each individual prayer to its designated gate among the supernal gates
tmp:1567: leha'alot nitzotzot le-Hashem Yitbarakh — elevating the holy sparks in things one sees to God, by immediately believing with complete faith that letters and sparks inhere in each thing
tmp:1568: leha'alot nitzotzei ha-dibbur — elevating the sparks of speech, the tikkun of speech achieved specifically through fasting (ta'anit), which blocks kelipot nursing from behind holiness
tmp:1570: shevach ha-tzaddikim — praising and glorifying the tzaddikim, the practice ('ka-nesher ya'ir kino') by which Da'at is raised and the mochin roused from slumber
tmp:1571: lehakim u-leromem et ha-da'at — establishing and elevating Da'at (the mind/awareness), accomplished through praise of the tzaddikim
tmp:1572: la-ro'im i efshar lehitkarev ki im — the principle that approach to the holy shepherds (source of emunah) is possible only through azut (holy boldness, 'az ka-namer')
tmp:1573: leharchiv u-leha'arikh yamav be-tosefot kedushah — the 'elder' (zaken) aspect: expanding/lengthening one's days with added holiness each day, attained via yirah ('yirat Hashem tosif yamim')
tmp:1574: lehashlim et da'ato — perfecting/completing one's Da'at so as to be whole in knowledge, the tzaddikim's true motive in drawing others near ('u-mi-talmidai yoter mi-kulam')
tmp:1575: rodfim achar bnei adam lekarvam la-avodato — the tzaddikim's pursuit of people to bring them close to God's service, done for completing da'at not for honor
tmp:1576: lehashlim da'atam — the tzaddikim's aim of completing the da'at of others (and thereby their own, via students), not increasing their honor
tmp:1578: luchot ha-even — the Tablets of Stone of Sinai, symbol of Chokhmah Ila'ah (supernal Wisdom), linked to the even shetiyah/Holy of Holies
tmp:1580: Levi — the tribe/priestly-levite lineage as symbol of the left side (smol), aspect of purity ('ve-tihart et bnei Levi') from which impurity seeks its hold
tmp:1581: lizkot la-kavod ha-zeh — meriting true honor (kavod with the kaf of Keter/Ehyeh), attainable only through teshuvah, chiefly by remaining silent when hearing one's disgrace
tmp:1582: she-tishmeru la'asot be-atzmekhem ha-mishpatim — executing judgment upon oneself (self-judgment of one's deeds), which nullifies the judgment from Above
tmp:1584: lizkor atzmo be-olam ha-ba — the constant remembrance of oneself in the World to Come ('ezkerah neginati ba-lailah'), keeping the alma de-atei always in mind
tmp:1586: yekasher et libo le-da'ato — binding one's heart to one's knowledge (da'at), so the general knowledge that God exists actually governs the heart and its middot
tmp:1587: lit'om ta'am or ha-ahavah she-be-da'at — tasting the light of the love contained within Da'at, accessible to each person even now 'within the days' according to his level
tmp:1588: mi she-yukhal la'asot niggunim — the one able to fashion the aforementioned melodies (niggunim), who thereby knows which children belong to each tzaddik and all future generations
tmp:1589: aniyut u-dechakut — poverty and material hardship/pressure as a condition of distress, aspect of night, the setting for redemptive Torah study
tmp:1590: tzar — distress/straits ('ba-tzar la-adam'), the state of affliction identified with night, in which Torah study rectifies speech
tmp:1592: Gemara — the Talmud/Oral Torah as text of study, symbolizing night (vs. Written Torah = day, per the Midrash of Moshe on the mountain)
tmp:1593: orev — the raven/crow (pushkantza in the Bava Batra tale), figure for studying Torah in order to be called 'Rabbi' (shelo lishmah)
tmp:1594: leilekh be-darkhei ha-teshuvah — walking the paths of repentance, requiring twofold expertise: baki be-ratzo (ascent, 'im esak shamayim') and baki be-shov (descent, 'atzi'ah she'ol')
tmp:1595: segulah lehinatzel mi-gadlut — a segulah (efficacious remedy) against arrogance: honoring the festivals and receiving Yom Tov with joy and expansive heart
